Brand Naming & Tagline Generator 1.0.0

- Initial release providing four structured branding prompts: brand name brainstorming, tagline generation, brand voice & messaging guide, and elevator pitch suite.
- Enables startups, freelancers, and small businesses to generate professional-quality brand names, taglines, and brand messaging.
- Outputs include name styles, tagline frameworks, tone guides, pitch templates, and actionable recommendations with explanations.
- Free tier includes brand name brainstorm; paid upgrades unlock the full feature set and a done-for-you option.
- Includes practical tips for domain and trademark checks, plus cross-sell recommendations for related branding and copywriting tools.
